tests.name: deduplicates redelivery and rolls back both inbox/job on failed creation; pins deployed version
two workers racing one job get exactly one lease; owner and version fence writes
limits active leases to two across concurrent workers
expired worker cannot checkpoint/result, even before recovery; new attempt rejects old token
SIGKILL/restart preserves checkpoint/key and recovers expired lease from durable DB
early durable event wakes WAITING once; wrong entity/correlation cannot wake; deadline survives restart
event concurrent with WAITING registration is never lost
honors Retry-After, caps technical failures at eight, and retains operation keys through retries
replay uses live IAM role/session, mandatory reason and CAS; preserves ID/version/key with audit
rejects missing/wrong audience/scope/workflow/expired machine tokens and public Gateway forwarding
runtime DB role cannot read IAM/n8n DB or create databases
IAM issues real bounded tokens; correct job/audience/scope reads Catalog and Class
rejects signature/audience/scope/expiry, raw domain token and scope escalation
accepts one-second issuance jitter while keeping absolute expiry and future-iat limits
rejects self-declared actor/role/branch/context and uncheckpointed operations
binds immutable context to event, workflow version, entity and input refs
checks current branch/teacher ownership in Class and restricts director delegation to one branch
fences authorization issuance and consumption after expiry, reclaim and completion
enforces machine grants and rotates credentials without retaining old tokens
fails closed if IAM or the configured lease authority is unavailable
revokes context, account permission and initiating session on the next request
honors existing IAM access/status administration revocation without an Org bypass
rejects inactive principals immediately for Bridge, minting and already-issued domain tokens
keeps missing approvals, business writes, unconfigured authority and public internal routes closed
